vibe_rationale: Big free street party with real local character and four stages, but broad, mass-attended and council-run rather than scene-specific.
fit_notes: High-footfall, mixed inner-north crowd with unpublished demographics and weak wellness adjacency. The 50,000 figure is a press upper bound. The route is a stall or sampling slot with no partnership contact published, so its value is reach rather than culture. The council deferred a proposal to make the party biennial, so the 2027 date is uncertain.
